scripts/checks/code-files.mjs: Classifies code and test paths and lists repo code files via git.
scripts/checks/count-lines.mjs: Counts lines in source text without adding a line for a trailing newline.
scripts/checks/file-size.mjs: Parses the legacy-oversize list and checks file line counts against the 450-line limit.
scripts/checks/legacy-ratchet.mjs: Rejects legacy-oversize list entries that were added or raised compared with the base list, and decides which base lists are acceptable.
scripts/checks/run-size-check.mjs: CLI that checks repo file sizes or writes the legacy-oversize allowlist.
scripts/ci/suite-tests.sh: Runs Story Block's cross-package suite tests and fails on skips, todos or missing results.
scripts/codemap/build-map.mjs: Builds sorted codemap rows and validates jobs and export limits.
scripts/codemap/cli.mjs: CLI that writes or verifies docs/codemap.md from source files and jobs.json.
scripts/codemap/parse-module.mjs: Extracts exports, import specifiers and CommonJS use from ES module source with a real parser.
scripts/codemap/pattern-names.mjs: Lists the names a destructuring or plain binding pattern declares.
scripts/codemap/render-map.mjs: Renders codemap rows into a deterministic markdown document.
scripts/verify-import.sh: Proves the imported package trees match the recorded source snapshots by comparing git tree hashes.
ui/card/card-row.js: Builds the card's top row: ‹ Story, time · place · weather (opens the Scene sheet) and ⚙.
ui/card/character-card.js: Builds the full character card shown on top of every tab, with a Story-only variant when RPG is off.
ui/chat/inline-row.js: Builds the quiet inline row under the latest reply: time, place, weather, money, Needs you, Fight, Choices and the Suite link.
ui/chat/people-drawer.js: Builds the people drawer above the message box: a "Here" header and one page of feelings-ring cards.
ui/contract/card.js: Defines the view-model shape for the shared character card.
ui/contract/chat.js: Defines the view-model shape for the chat inline row, people drawer, and reply menu.
ui/contract/now.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Now tab.
ui/contract/shapes.js: Checks a value against a plain shape spec and lists mismatches by path.
ui/css/base.css: Base styles: reset, font and focus rules for everything inside the suite root.
ui/css/card.css: Character card styles (decisions 19-21): tokens renamed from --g-* to --su-*.
ui/css/chat.css: Inline row and people drawer: SillyTavern theme variables only, never the suite tokens (decision 34).
ui/css/kit.css: Kit styles: the one button, chip, switch and segmented-control family, sized for touch.
ui/css/now.css: Styles for the Now tab cards, the Show-all list, the spoiler switch and the feelings ring; tokens only.
ui/css/shell.css: Shell styles: sliding root, dimmed chat, sky backdrop, tab strip, phone bar and mini bar. Layout follows the container, never the viewport.
ui/dev/harness.js: Dev harness: mounts the suite on the fake port with theme, variant and width switches (also driven by the URL query).
ui/fixtures/index.js: Builds plain-JSON story-state view-model fixtures and variants (default, rpgOff, fightOpen, empty).
ui/fixtures/moment.js: Shared story-state fixture at 9:30 am in the Bluewatch Guild Office, plus the 2:10 pm bridge fight state.
ui/fixtures/people.js: Shared cast fixture covering present NPCs, away party/contacts, deceased, dormant, and bridge-fight overrides.
ui/index.js: Public face of the new Story Suite view: re-exports the mount function, the port contract and the fake port.
ui/kit/bars.js: Draws the three equal Health, Mana and Stamina bars and the thin EXP bar of the character card.
ui/kit/controls.js: Provides the suite's single control family: button, chip, switch toggle and segmented control.
ui/kit/dom.js: Builds DOM and SVG elements from tag names, attributes and children using text nodes only.
ui/kit/glyphs.js: Provides the suite's SVG glyph set as structured path data and an element builder.
ui/kit/more.js: Shows the first few rows of a list and a "Show all N" / "Show fewer" button for the rest.
ui/kit/ring.js: Draws the feelings ring: four quarter arcs (trust, affection, desire, tension) sized by each meter, none for zero.
ui/kit/spoiler.js: Builds the spoiler switch row and the hidden-until-shown text used for scene secrets.
ui/mount.js: Mounts the suite on a port: builds the shell and tab host, wires back-stack and redraw, and returns open, close and destroy.
ui/port/contract.js: Defines the UI-to-engine port method contract and validates port implementations.
ui/port/fake-port.js: Fake engine port that serves fixture view-models, records commands, and emits events on demand.
ui/runtime/back-stack.js: Manages the Escape and back stack in order: menu, sheet, page, settings, suite, chat.
ui/runtime/prefs.js: Stores fold state per device and spoiler levels per chat through the port.
ui/runtime/redraw.js: Coalesces change events into one frame and redraws only changed sections.
ui/shell/default-views.js: Supplies the default card and tab renderers for mountSuite: the character card, the Now tab, and a "not built yet" card.
ui/shell/suite-view.js: Builds the suite root that slides in over the chat, sized from its container and centred over a dimmed chat on desktop.
ui/shell/tab-host.js: Builds the 8-tab host: tablet strip, phone bottom bar, scrolling panel and the mini bar shown after the card scrolls away.
ui/tabs/now/here.js: Builds the Here card: people present with their feelings ring and the Scene spoiler for wants and hiding.
ui/tabs/now/now.js: Composes the Now tab in phone order: Right now, Here, This turn, You, Pinned; two columns when the container is wide.
ui/tabs/now/right-now.js: Builds the two "Right now" cards: Needs you (actions only) and Today (focus, trip, due soon, torn gear).
ui/tabs/now/this-turn.js: Builds the This reply card: what the reply changed, exceptions first, five rows then Show all, with Why on held-back lines.
ui/tabs/now/you-pinned.js: Builds the folded You card (look, position, condition) and the pinned tracker cards.
ui/theme/apply.js: Writes a token set on the suite root and refuses values that are not colour, length or font.
ui/theme/follow-st.js: Maps SillyTavern's theme variables to tokens and decides light or dark.
ui/theme/sky.js: Time-of-day backdrop gradient (pack art replaces it).
ui/theme/tokens.js: Token names and the Glass dark and light values.
